pages.text: The $(item)Seed Pouch$() is a type of $(l:sns/item_containers)Item Container$() intended for holding a large variety of seeds making it very useful when farming. $(br2)By default these have 27 slots holding up to 64 seeds each
For modpack authors or simply people wishing to add extra seeds see the item tag $(bold)sns:allowed_in_seed_pouch$() most addons should be automatically supported
